content.bridge_context: Classifying materials based on their physical and chemical properties.

units.title: Physical Properties
units.explanation: Metals: Shiny (Lustrous), Hard, Malleable (can be beaten into sheets), Ductile (can be drawn into wires).
units.dual_language_instruction: Name a shiny metal. / एक चमकदार धातु का नाम बताएं।

units.title: Conduction
units.explanation: Metals are good conductors of heat and electricity. Non-metals are usually poor conductors.
units.dual_language_instruction: Why are cooking pans made of metal? / खाना पकाने के बर्तन धातु के क्यों बने होते हैं?
